SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS distinct_subjects,
  SUM(d.FEE) AS total_fee,
  MIN(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(

      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')

    )
  ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(
      MINUTE,
      STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
      CASE
        WHEN STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') > STR_TO_DATE(s.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
          THEN STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')

      END
    )
  ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d

WITH virtual_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    s.SESSION_START_TIME,
    s.SESSION_END_TIME
  FROM IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION s
  LEFT JOIN BUILDINGS b
    ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.SESSION_LOCATION
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL
),
session_durations AS (
  SELECT
    vs.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    CASE
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NULL
        OR STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p') IS NULL
        THEN NULL
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p') <= STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
        THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
               MINUTE,
               STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
               STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_END_TIME, '%h%i%p')
             )
      ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(
             MINUTE,
             STR_TO_DATE(vs.SESSION_START_TIME, '%h%i%p'),
             STR_TO_DATE('1200PM', '%h%i%p')
           )
    END AS duration_minutes
  FROM virtual_sessions vs
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(d.FEE) AS total_fee,
  MIN(sd.duration_minutes) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(sd.duration_minutes) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL d
JOIN session_durations sd
  ON sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY;	----- bird -----	dw

WITH dlc_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    DLC_KEY,
    DLC_NAME
  FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION
),
sd_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    su.DLC_KEY,
    dn.DLC_NAME,

    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT

    ON dn.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY
  LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb
    ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
),
dlc_supervisors AS (
  SELECT
    DEPT_NAMES AS DLC_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS total_supervisors,
    SUM(NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS total_supervisees
  FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE
  GROUP BY DEPT_NAMES
)

SELECT
  ata.TERM_CODE,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = CAST(YEAR(CURDATE()) AS CHAR)
         AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
  END AS IS_CURRENT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS DISTINCT_CIS_COURSE_TYPES
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata
LEFT JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER atp
  ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc
  ON ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
 AND (
      (RIGHT(ata.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'FA' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(ata.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'JA' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(ata.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SP' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
   OR (RIGHT(ata.TERM_CODE, 2) = 'SU' AND ccc.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'Y')
 )
GROUP BY
  ata.TERM_CODE,
  ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  CASE
    WHEN ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = CAST(YEAR(CURDATE()) AS CHAR)
         AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'
    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N'
  END
ORDER BY ata.TERM_CODE;	----- bird -----	dw

    WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'

),
fall_tokens AS (
    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, offered_term, TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE
            WHEN FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NULL OR TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) = '' THEN ''
            WHEN INSTR(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',') > 0 THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, INSTR(FALL_INSTRUCTORS, ',') + 1))
            ELSE ''
        END AS rest
    FROM base
    WHERE FALL_INSTRUCTORS IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(FALL_INSTRUCTORS) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, offered_term, TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rest, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE

            WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0 THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1))
            ELSE ''
        END AS rest
    FROM fall_tokens

    SELECT
        SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, TOTAL_UNITS, offered_term, TERM_DESCRIPTION,
        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, ',', 1)) AS instructor,
        CASE

            ELSE ''
        END AS rest
    FROM base

        TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(rest, ',', 1)) AS instructor,

            WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0 THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1))

all_totals AS (

  FROM building_totals

    WHEN GROUPING(b.floor_number) = 1 THEN CONCAT(b.building_name, ' - SUBTOTAL')
    WHEN GROUPING(b.room_number) = 1 THEN CONCAT(b.building_name, ' - FLOOR ', b.floor_number, ' SUBTOTAL')
